bennie-tinson.text: Platform: transform Long Beach Boulevard by eradicating sex trafficking and attracting new dining, shopping and 'attainable mixed-use housing developments.'

anthony-perry.text: (2020) In Ballotpedia's survey as a State Senate candidate, listed key messages: 'End homelessness, Jobs for all, Quality education.'
(2019) In Ballotpedia's survey, listed key messages 'People over party, Pro- Choice, Pro- Taxpayer.'
(2017) As a school board candidate told Ballotpedia new charter schools should not be approved in his district and the state should not fund private schools through vouchers.
(2017) Told Ballotpedia teachers should receive merit pay for exceeding goals.
